profile.summary: Regency Ceramics Limited engages in the manufacturing and sale of ceramic floor and wall tiles in India and internationally. It offers glazed vitrified, parking, and heavy-duty tiles for high traffic areas; and polished vitrified tiles, wall tiles, and special tiles. The company was incorporated in 1983 and is based in Hyderabad, India.
